scope: Only profiles whose existing action field is empty; frozen v1 is not modified
evidence: Literal Task substrings only; no Problem/Context inheritance or inferred synonyms
limits: Development-corpus-informed lexical coverage repair, not verified semantic role parsing or performance improvement

rules.reason: Korean operation nouns absent from the frozen semantic action lexicon; require token boundary
Initial operation verbs in imperative-style Task summaries; not arbitrary interior noun matches
Preserve coordinated explicit operation in Prepare and submit
Extract literal advice only when licensed by initial Give phrase; do not invent Advise
Restrict ambiguous Document to recording-conversation construction; Document retrieval is not document-as-verb
Restrict ambiguous Book to explicit leave-booking construction; book titles are not operations
Restrict Screen to applicant-screening construction, not display-screen nouns
Preserve coordinated explicit assessment operation with applicant object
